atomicity.reason: One obligation (the per-tick accumulator update); the first-tick sentence is an edge case of the same rule.

comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained: the tick period, the operands, the factor and the accumulator unit are all present.

feasibility.reason: A two-sample trapezoidal accumulation at 100 Hz is trivial on any BMS microcontroller and matches the parent's 64-bit fixed-point accumulator.

parent_fit.reason: ARCH_COULOMB_COUNTER owns trapezoidal integration of signed pack current on a fixed 10 ms tick into an ampere-second accumulator; this requirement states that update exactly.

unambiguity.reason: 'the mean of the current sample of this tick and the current sample of the previous tick multiplied by 0.01 seconds' can be parsed with the 0.01 s factor applying to the mean or only to the previous sample.
unambiguity.suggestion: Write the formula unambiguously, e.g. 'shall add ((I(n) + I(n-1)) / 2) x 0.01 s to its ampere-second accumulator'.

verifiability.reason: A closed-form update with a stated tick period and accumulator unit lets a test feed a current sequence and assert the accumulator value.

summary: Exact trapezoidal update rule matching ARCH_COULOMB_COUNTER, with the initialisation case handled; the prose formula has an operator-precedence ambiguity.
